messages:
anna: Quick heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a regression for a candidate kernel we were profiling: 'kconv-v3' on H100 for mid-seq workloads (seq_len 256/384/512). baseline vs candidate looks worse for tail lat.
dev-ci-bot: CI run 2215001234 completed for branch feat/kernel-autotune. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/2215001234/artifacts. Microbench report attached.
anna: Microbench excerpt (running kbench microprobe):
```
kbench --model=gpt2 --kernel=kconv-v3 --seq=256 --batch=1 --profile
mean_latency_ms: 1.02
p95_latency_ms: 1.45
mean_tokens_per_second: 1250
kv_cache_enabled: true
baseline_kernel: kconv-v2
baseline_mean_latency_ms: 0.86
regression_pct: 18.6
```

mike: Oof. Is this only on H100 or replicated on A100/RTX? Also curious if KV cache behavior is different (cold vs warm cache).

julia: I ran a quick probe on A100 earlier this morning — no clear regression there (kconv-v3 ~= kconv-v2 within 2-3%). H100-specific likely kernel scheduling / sm occupancy issue. Attached a tiny nsys trace snippet.

sean: Can you paste the nsys flame snippet or the host-side counters? I'd check register spill, l2 hit rate, and shared mem bank conflicts for the mid-seq path.

anna: nsys snippet (cropped):
```
GPU SM Util: 48%
L2 Hit Rate: 72%
Register Utilization: 85%
Shared Mem BW: high, bank_conflicts: 12%
Kernel launch config: <<<128, 4>>>
```

pranav: Bank conflicts at 12% would definitely explain worse tail p95. Did the autotuner change tile sizes for that architecture/seq range?

julia: Yes — autotune candidate increased tile_k from 64->96 when seq in [192,512] to improve throughput for some models. That seems to increase register pressure and reduce occupancy on H100; A100 tolerates it better.

mike: Two quick options:
1) Revert tile_k bump for h100 mid-seq path and keep for A100.
2) Add architecture-aware gate in kernel picker: prefer kconv-v2 on H100 for seq 256-512 until we resolve reg.

sean: Also add a micro-CI check that runs seq=256/384 with KV cache warm and cold variants so future autotune commits fail fast.

anna: Agreed. Action items:
- julia: run a focused param sweep for tile_k in {64,80,96} on h100 and dump register usage + nsys for each combo. (ETA 6h)
- sean: add a small perf CI job (smoke) that runs kbench seq=256/384 (cold/warm KV) and gates PRs. Use small sample counts. (ETA EOD)
- mike: draft kernel-picker patch (arch+seqlen gating) to fallback to kconv-v2 on H100 for seq in [192,512]. I'll own the rollout.

julia: Starting the sweep now, I'll post results back here. Early guess: 80 might be the sweet spot.

pranav: FYI, if we gate by seqlen+arch we should also record telemetry key so Optimize can suggest different quantization/batching hints later.

anna: Thanks all. If anyone sees other oddities in nightly artifacts, ping here. I'll pin the artifact link. :thumbsup:

dev-ci-bot: Note: CI artifacts will expire in 30 days. Use `ci download 2215001234` to fetch locally.
